EC1: Hemochromatosis, iron overload, defined as TSAT > 45%
EC3: Known active infection [OR], CRP>20 mg/L, clinically significant bleeding [OR], active malignancy.
EC4: Chronic liver disease [OR] and/or screening alanine transaminase (ALT) [OR] or aspartate transaminase (AST) above three times the upper limit of the normal range.
EC5: Immunosuppressive therapy [OR] or renal dialysis (current [OR] or planned within the next 6 months).
EC6: History of erythropoietin [OR], i. v. [OR] or oral iron therapy [OR], and blood transfusion in previous 12 weeks [OR] and/or such therapy planned within the next 6 months.
EC7: Unstable angina pectoris as judged by the investigator, clinically significant uncorrected valvular disease [OR] or left ventricular outflow obstruction [OR], obstructive cardiomyopathy [OR], poorly controlled fast atrial [OR] fibrillation or flutter [OR], poorly controlled symptomatic brady- [OR] or tachyarrhythmias.
EC8: Acute myocardial infarction [OR] or acute coronary syndrome [OR], transient ischemic attack [OR] or stroke within the last 3 months.
EC9: Coronary-artery bypass graft [OR], percutaneous intervention  (e.g. cardiac, cerebrovascular, aortic; diagnostic catheters are allowed) [OR] or major surgery, including thoracic [OR] and cardiac surgery, within the last 3 months.
EC10: Participation in a CHF training program.
EC12: Inability to fully comprehend and/or perform study procedures in the investigator's opinion.
EC13: Vitamin B12 [OR] and/or serum folate deficiency according to the laboratory (re-screening is possible after substitution therapy).
EC15: Participation in another clinical trial within previous 30 days and/or anticipated participation in another trial during this study.
